description: DEPRECATED: use planka_find_cards with listId. Same arguments, same handler, same response.

boardId.description: Board ID. Optional with PLANKA_DEFAULT_BOARD_ID; ignored when listId is given.

descriptionChars.description: Per-match description preview, in characters. 0 (the default) leaves descriptions out.

detail.description: digest (default): id, name, labels, members, tasks, dueDate, commentsTotal, updatedAt. full: every field of the card, description included.

labelIds.description: Only cards carrying at least one of these label IDs (OR).

labelName.description: Only cards carrying this label name (exact name, case- and accent-insensitive). If the board has no such label, the response says so and lists the ones it does have.

limit.description: Max matches to return. Default 25, max 200.

listId.description: Read exactly this column. THE CHEAP PATH: one request, no pagination, so total is the real size of the column and truncated is false by construction.

listName.description: Column name fragment (case- and accent-insensitive) instead of an ID. Costs a board read; listId is cheaper.

offset.description: Skip this many matches. Use nextOffset from the previous response.

query.description: Free text matched against card name AND description. Several words are ANDed — all must appear — ignoring case and accents. A leading '/' makes the rest a case-insensitive regular expression.

userIds.description: Only cards where one of these users is a member or a task assignee (OR).

withLabels.description: Resolve label names. Default true; false skips one board read on the listId path.

name: planka_list_cards
title: List cards in a column
